narr: Early morning storms drifting northward into southern Socorro County near the Oscura Mountains produced heavy rainfall. This resulted in water running over WSMR Range Road 7 that was two to three feet deep. Mud and debris was also reported.
ev: There were several flood areas along White Sands Missile Range Road Seven. Water was two to three feet deep with mud and debris on the road.
lsr: Several flooded areas along WSMR Range Road 7. Water 2-3 ft deep at this location. Mud and debris on road.
